content:
sasha: ran nsys on staging after the kernel-selector change (commit c2a9f3). seeing a recurring 20–40ms spike that aligns with the kernel switch in the timeline. uploading the trace: https://perf.redwood/test/1994012345
perf-bot: trace uploaded: https://perf.redwood/test/1994012345 (10.2MB)
mike: quick q — are we seeing the spike on single-request latency or only with batching enabled?
 sasha: only when batcher.batch_size >= 8 and batcher.max_latency_ms <= 12. single-request runs look fine.
 anya: could be KV cache eviction leaking into user request spans. our current NVTX ranges only mark the global runtime phases, not per-request kvcache ops.
 rajesh: agree. traces currently show the big GEMM kernel and then a small memcpy right after; without per-request NVTX we attribute the memcpy to the wrong request.
 taylor: proposal: add per-request NVTX ranges that wrap kvcache ops and batch routing. naming: "req/<req_id>/kvcache" and "req/<req_id>/batch-route" — unique, searchable, short.
 mike: fine, but watch length and allocate on hot paths. NVTX push/pop is cheap but not zero. let's only enable per-request NVTX behind a flag that sampling/traces enable.
 sasha: here's a minimal pattern we'd add in runtime (pseudo):
```
// on request start
nvtxRangePushA(fmt("req/%s/request", req_id));
// before kvcache lookup
nvtxRangePushA("req/<id>/kvcache");
// kvcache lookup
nvtxRangePop();
// rest of request
nvtxRangePop();
```
 anya: small tweak — prefer ascii label without spaces, keep <id> short (hex 8 chars). add "rt:batch-route" suffix for router ranges so they stand out in perf searches.
 rajesh: also add a short tag for kernel selector decision points: nvtxRangeStart("selector:pick", kernel_hint)
 taylor: once we have per-request kvcache ranges we can filter traces to measure how often kvcache leads to memcpy/evict and correlate with kernel choice.
 mike: can someone run nsys with sampling enabled and v3 of nvtx labels? i can repro locally if you point me at the branch.
sasha: branch is perf/trace/per-request-nvtx, push in 5m. I'll attach the repro script and an example perfetto slice after the nvtx labels are in.
perf-bot: build succeeded for perf/trace/per-request-nvtx @c2a9f3 — artifact: https://ci.redwood/artifacts/1994012345
anya: one more ask — add a debug toggle so we can emit per-request NVTX for a single request id to reduce noise while reproducible.
taylor: agreed. let's land the flag behind TRACE_PER_REQUEST_NVTX and default off. I'll add docs in instrumentation guide.
mike: ok LGTM. I'll run the nsys sweep and post a short summary with timestamps. :thumbsup:
